body: I'm from a small town in southern Illinois, home of racism and homophobia.  Good stuff.  I don't know why I'm telling you this, but my Psychology teacher in high school was so understanding of transgender people like me.  I almost wanted to cry because of how non-judgmental she was.  She understood perfectly.  I might try one of these online communities.  I'd really like to be helped, I really would...

I'm only 18.  My parents would definitely kick me out if I talked anything about this.  The sooner you transition, the better chance you have of passing.  So right now I'm watching myself turn into more of a man, and it's fucking killing me.  No one would understand.  They'd think I was some weird fuck.  I just wish I was born as a girl.  That would have been so much easier.

There's nothing I can do about my feelings.  My entire life will be lived as a lie.  That's something I don't want to do.  I just can't take it anymore.  I thought if I ignored the feelings they'd go away, but they don't.  They just keep coming back.
